news.title: MSPIL Achieves Record Sugar Production in 2024-25 Season
news.content: Mahakaushal Sugar & Power Industries Ltd. has achieved a record sugar production of 95,000 MT in the current crushing season, marking a 15% increase from the previous year.
news.author: MSPIL Team

news.title: Ethanol Production Capacity Expansion Complete
news.content: Our ethanol distillery has successfully completed its capacity expansion project, increasing daily production from 300 KLPD to 350 KLPD, supporting India's ethanol blending program.
news.author: MSPIL Team

news.title: Power Generation Efficiency Improved by 8%
news.content: Implementation of new turbine technology has resulted in an 8% improvement in power generation efficiency at our 24 MW co-generation plant.
news.author: MSPIL Team

news.title: Sugar Market Shows Positive Trends for Q1 2025
news.content: Market analysis indicates favorable sugar prices and strong demand in domestic and international markets, benefiting sugar producers across India.
news.author: Market Analyst
